name: Archetype Outputs
tagline: Five automatic derivations. Set the modifiers once; the outputs follow.
body: Modifiers are recorded as signed values across six axes — H (hip), G (glute), A (arch mass), T (thigh), W (waist), BA (back arch) — and the five outputs below are computed from them rather than invented per profile. This is the single most common source of drift in the old documents: a profile whose stated hips do not follow from its stated modifiers.
rules: HMM — Hip Measurement Modifier: applies inches to the build's baseline hips. Even-number rule applies on rounding.
TDM — Thigh Density Category: from Plush through Devotional Thick.
BAS — Back Arch Severity: Low · Moderate · Deep · Obscene · Weaponized.
GG — Gap Geometry: the named shape of the gap the two archetypes produce together.
AMD — Ass Mass Distribution: where the mass sits, and what it does under impact.
